params.body:
Ilse could not switch a dealer's modules on. Twice, two days running, at the start of an onboarding: Garage Verbeke on 21 September, Garage Du Centre on 22 September. She ticks module 1 and 2 and nothing is saved. No confirmation dialog, no request in the network tab, nothing in the console, nothing in Nightwatch, nothing in the log.

`x-ui.autofilter` fetches the filtered list and **replaces the rows in the table** with new nodes. The switches were bound with `$(".module_1_switch").on('change', ...)` to the elements that existed at page load. After a search those are gone, so there is no handler at all.

**Why it looked random.** The search term is kept in the session, so a plain refresh makes the server render the filtered rows itself and the binding does work. That is Ilse's "it worked in the end" of the 21st: nothing had been repaired, she had reloaded.

**What it took to find.** Five explanations were ruled out by reading: the URL (`route()` keeps `::id`, the replace works), the controller (it just writes), `custom.ask` and `_confirm` (signature and callbacks are correct), an expired CSRF token (Shane had it straight after loading), and a separate phone rendering (there is none). What turned it was not more code but one observation from Shane — no dialog *and* no request — which put it before the send, and then it was visible that both he and Ilse had searched first.

The three switches now hang delegated on the document. A failed save puts the tick back and says "Opslaan is mislukt": a tick that stays on while nothing was stored is exactly how you believe you gave a dealer access he does not have.

**The guard found a second one.** `AFilteredRowKeepsItsSwitchesTest` checks every screen with an autofilter, not just the one where it bit, and immediately turned up the "delivered" switch on the won biddings — the same latent bug, never reported. Fixed with it (and a stray `console.log('loaded')` removed).

New rule `R P2-1.10`; finding `een-gefilterde-rij-verloor-haar-schakelaars`.

Full suite green, build green.

**Already done, outside this PR**: Garage Du Centre (id 576) has module 1 and 2 set directly in the database, at Shane's request, so this morning's onboarding was not blocked.
params.title: A filtered row keeps its switches
